newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan September trade surplus up 217 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan September trade surplus up 217 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Taiwan had a trade surplus of US$2.1195 billion in September, up 217.4 percent from a surplus of US$667.7 million in September 1995, the finance ministry said on Monday.
The following is a table of trade figures in millions of U.S. dollars:
September 1996 September 1995
Exports 9,841 8,717
Imports 7,721 8,049
Trade balance +2,120 +668
Exports in September rose 12.9 percent from September 1995 to US$9.841 billion, while imports fell a year-on-year 4.1 percent to $7.721 billion, the ministry said in a statement.
The surplus for the first three quarters of 1996 was $10.172 billion, up 155.2 percent from the same 1995 period, it said.
Exports in the first three quarters totalled $85.622 billion and imports stood at $75.451 billion, the ministry said.
Ministry's statistics department chief Hsu Kuo-chung said Taiwan's 1996 full-year trade surplus "definitely" would surpass $12 billion, against $8.12 billion for all of 1995.
"It (the surplus) is likely to reach $13 billion," Hsu said without giving reasons for the rise.
The United States was Taiwan's top export destination in September. Exports to the U.S. rose 13.2 percent to $2.4 billion, accounting for 24.4 percent of the monthly total.
Exports to Hong Kong were up 12.3 percent to $2.230 billion and exports to Japan rose 3.2 percent to $1.069 billion.
Exports to Europe rose 23.2 percent to $1.412 billion, representing 14.3 percent of the total.
Imports from Japan fell 6.1 percent in September to $2.087 billion, accounting for 27 percent of the total.
Imports from the United States fell 22.9 percent to $1.383 billion, or 17.9 percent of the total.
Taiwan's trade surplus with the United States was at $1.015 billion, up 210.9 percent from September 1995.
The surplus with Hong Kong rose 13.6 percent to $2.091 billion from a year ago.
The deficit with Japan was down 14.3 percent to $1.018 billion. Taiwan recorded a surplus of $55.1 million with Europe, against a deficit of $273.1 million in September 1995.
Electronic equipment and machinery remained the star sector of Taiwan's exports in September, totalling $4.421 billion or 44.9 percent of the total.
-- Taipei Newsroom (5080815)
